designDecisions.decision: An integrated estate composition was considered but not constructed.
A hierarchy of main residence, private accommodation and service spaces was considered.
Do not invent shoreline positions, flood levels or legal setbacks.
Shading, sheltered openings and cross-ventilation opportunities were considered.
Connected living, dining and sheltered terraces were considered.
A sheltered recessed entrance was considered.
Flat roof edges were considered without claiming waterproofing or drainage.
Split-level organization was not selected for the flat site.
Upper floors require physical support, stairs, landings and coordinated slab voids.
Material colours cannot establish coastal corrosion or hurricane performance.
designDecisions.limitation: No material specifications or engineering were produced.
